newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Ecopetrol to get $300 mln Japanese loan.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Ecopetrol to get $300 mln Japanese loan.

text.p: Colombia state oil company Ecopetrol will receive a $300 million from the Eximbank of Japan to help finance development of the Cusiana and Cupiagua crude oil fields in its eastern plains, the company's president said.
Luis Bernardo Florez told Reuters the seven-year credit would be signed in Japan next Monday and that interest had been set at 0.34 points above LIBOR.
The credit will be used to help boost oil production in Cusiana and Cupiagua, which is expected to rise from 175,000 barrels per day by the end of this year to 320,000 barrels in 1997, Florez said.
